description: This file defines utility functions and a class for indexing admin console sections and plugin entries for search functionality in the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: An interface for search index with methods to add elements and perform searches.

methods.name: pushText
methods.description: Adds a string or formatted message to the texts array based on its type.

methods.name: extractTextsFromSection
methods.description: Extracts searchable texts from an admin console section, including title, name, and searchable strings.

methods.name: extractTextFromSettings
methods.description: Extracts searchable texts from admin console settings.

methods.name: adminDefinitionsToUrlsAndTexts
methods.description: Converts admin definitions into URL-to-text mappings for search indexing.

methods.name: generateIndex
methods.description: Creates and populates a search index with admin console sections and plugin entries.

methods.name: addToIndex
methods.description: Adds entries to the search index by concatenating their texts.
